values.note: Gogebic County's 2027 rates: nightly $30 (resident and non-resident alike); monthly $600 resident / $700 non-resident (30-night discount by promo code, residency checked at check-in); seasonal $1,650 / $1,950, lakeside seasonal +$150. Boat launch $3/day or $20/year.

values.note: Camping season mid-May to late September (2027: to September 26); seasonal sites may be occupied mid-May to the end of September.

values.note: Reservations open the second Monday in January and are online only (the county's NewBook page); one reservation per site occupant and date range. Seasonal sites are reserved by phone from the same Monday. Office (906) 842-3333 in season, (906) 663-4428 October-May.

booking.source: https://www.gogebicforestryandparks.com/lakegogebic ('Reservations for the Lake Gogebic County Park begin the second Monday in January each year via website only!'; 'All reservations must be processed online'; reservation icon -> bookingsus.newbook.cloud/lakegogebic), read 2026-10-22

note: On the SW shore of Lake Gogebic (N8598 Hwy M-64, Marenisco), run by Gogebic County Forestry & Parks; boat launch, pier, swimming area, pavilion, playground, camper waste removal service. Many sites are seasonal (including lakeside ones); the rest are nightly or monthly. Sites fit RVs to ~50 ft. (Distinct from Lake Gogebic STATE PARK ~3 mi away.) --Claude
summary: County page confirms 53 electric 30/50-amp sites with water access, dump + waste removal service, no public WiFi; 2027 nightly $30 for residents and non-residents (monthly $600/$700, seasonal $1,650/$1,950); season mid-May to Sept 26 (2027); online-only booking on NewBook from the second Monday in January; phone 906-842-3333 matches (off-season 906-663-4428). Water left as recorded (page says 'water access to all sites', not explicitly at-site hookups); max_rig_ft 50 left (page silent). Note trimmed of hookup/count/fee/booking text.
flags: Seasonal share (county park, so no long-stay test applies): the page says the campground 'offers seasonal sites' and 'a number of sites also available for nightly or monthly camping reservations'; the split is not stated.
